rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and thinned zona, but the response overstates confidence in ICM location/quadrant and TE cohesiveness from a single image; some described details are not clearly discernible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, PCOS, prior IVF outcomes, sperm motility, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor overconfidence around morphology and exact outcome ranges.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with SET for a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst, avoidance of unproven add-ons, and selective use of PGT-A; minor wording issues but no major guideline conflicts.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, lifestyle modification, luteal support review, cavity assessment, male-factor review, and metabolic optimization.
